heading: Sunday Night
text: Becoming mostly cloudy, with rain showers developing overnight. Icy over the higher terrain. Lows in the mid 30s, near 40 through the Champlain valley. Light and variable wind.

heading: Monday
text: Mostly cloudy, Morning rain showers west and south of I-89, becoming scattered, steady in the northern mountains. Highs in the 40s to near 50 north, low to mid 50s in the broad valleys.

heading: Monday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Light showers north tapering off early. Lows in the 30s, near 30 over the higher terrain north.
